jobs.description: About the Role The Engineering Acceleration team builds and operates the foundational systems that engineers use to build, test, and ship ChatGPT, the API, and OpenAI's infrastructure. We are looking for an engineer to help evolve OpenAI's build and continuous integration systems for a fast-growing engineering organization. This role sits at the intersection of developer productivity, build systems, distributed infrastructure, and software quality. You will work on the systems that determine how quickly and confidently engineers can move: Bazel-based builds, Buildkite pipelines, test selection, remote caching and execution, CI observability, and tooling that helps engineers understand and fix failures quickly. Our mission is to make OpenAI one of the most productive engineering organizations in the world while preserving a high bar for correctness, reliability, and safety. The best version of this work is invisible when it succeeds: builds are fast, tests are trusted, CI failures are understandable, and engineers can focus on shipping useful systems instead of fighting infrastructure. We see our people as, well, people - with interests, families, friends, dreams, and causes that are all important to them. Our focus is on the health and safety of our teammates as well as work-life balance and diversity and inclusion. From generous benefits to a variety of employee resource groups, we strive to build paths that encourage employees to stretch themselves professionally. We want to help you grow, develop, and learn new things. You’re constantly evolving, so shouldn’t your opportunities be, too? Hybrid roles are generally expected to be in the office a certain number of days per week as indicated by your manager. The Opportunity Ally is seeking a Physical Security Event & Travel Risk Intelligence Manager to join our Physical Security organization to support delivering proactive and real-time intelligence for high-visibility Ally sponsored events and executive engagements. In this role, you will partner closely with Travel & Entertainment, Marketing, Executive Protection, and Physical Security Intelligence teams to assess risk, monitor threats, and ensure the safety of employees and leadership during corporate events. You will be responsible for conducting threat intelligence analysis, supporting event planning through risk assessments, and developing emergency action plans (EAPs) that address employee and executive exposure. This role also plays a critical role in supporting Executive Protection, providing ongoing intelligence and situational awareness for the CEO and other executives during Ally sponsored events, travel, and public-facing activities. This is a 24/7, event-driven role that requires flexibility to support evolving threats and real-time operational needs. Candidates must be willing to work non-traditional hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays, and respond to live security or life safety incidents as they arise. As the Physical Security Event & Travel Risk Intelligence Manager, you will lead intelligence efforts tied to corporate and executive events, ensuring risks are identified, assessed, and mitigated through proactive planning and real-time support. jobs.description: If you’re passionate about helping people protect what matters most to them at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, as well as innovating and simplifying processes and operations to provide the best customer value, then Nationwide’s Property and Casualty team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care. This is a work-from-home position with day travel to policy locations (on average 3-4 days a week) via company vehicle (personal use, gas and maintenance included). Claims inspections will include onsite and virtual inspection. The selected individual must reside in the respective territory: Territory: This role will cover IN, MI, IL and other surrounding areas (Up to 50% travel) Ideal Candidate Locations: The ideal candidate will live in the Northern IN area. Occasional travel outside of the territory may be required. Relocation assistance may be available for qualified candidates who reside more than 50 miles outside of the ideal candidate locations listed. Qualifications: · 5 years of insurance field/property claims handling or adjusting experience (large loss - preferred) · Solid experience/proficiency with Xactimate · Solid experience writing own estimates and handling claims start to finish · Construction background/experience- Residential, Roofing, Remodeling, water mitigation, etc · Strong customer service competency · Strong written & verbal communication skills PLEASE NOTE that CAT duty is required for this position. Benefits Include: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401k with company match, Company-paid Pension plan, Paid time off and more. #LI-JJ1 #LI-Remote Job Description Summary No two property claims are ever the same and each customer has unique needs. Our team thrives on providing the very best service and building lasting, successful relationships with our customers. If you are confident, curious, driven to learn and grow, and have a desire to help people when they most need it, we want to know more about you! As a Claims Specialist, you'll work to evaluate and resolve serious exposure, large loss claims requiring investigation, liability evaluation and negotiation. We'll count on you to expedite settlements and control average loss cost and litigation expense according to the best claims practices. Job Description Key Responsibilities: Handles all assigned claims promptly and effectively, with little direction and oversight, which may include complicated and catastrophic losses. Makes decisions within delegated authority, recommends settlement values in the disposition of claims as outlined in company policies and procedures. Accurately pays claims based on policy provisions, state mandates and/or fee schedules. Determines proper policy coverages and applies standard methodologies to conclude assigned cases according to company guidelines. Adheres to high standards of professional conduct while delivering outstanding service. Opens, closes and adjusts reserves according to company practices to ensure reserve adequacy. Maintains knowledge of court decisions that may affect the claim's function; current principles and practices; innovations; and policy changes and modifications. May be required to maintain knowledge of other functions within assigned subject area. This may require attending various seminars or training sessions. Maintains current knowledge of local industry repair procedures and local market pricing. Able to act for Claims Manager. Mentors and provides leadership to less experienced claims associates. Provides one-on-one training and assists with training/presentations as assigned by claims management. Creates and analyzes severe incident reports, reinsurance reports and other information to corporate office, claims management and underwriting. Partners with Special Investigation Unit and Subrogation to identify fraud and subrogation opportunities. Assist general counsel to prepares files for suit, trial or subrogation. Consults claims staff and defense counsel for discovery processes and lawsuit file/trial strategy on case-specific issues. Initiates and conducts follow-ups through proficient use of the claims and other related business systems. Delivers an outstanding customer service experience to all internal, external, current and prospective Nationwide customers. Performs other responsibilities as assigned . Reporting Relationships: Reports to Claims Manager. Individual contributor role. Typical Skills and Experiences: Education: Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience preferred. Advanced degrees in law or related field desirable. License/Certification/Designation: Successful completion of required claims certification schools/courses. Professional development such as IIA or CPCU preferred. State licensing where required. Experience: Five years of experience handling property claims, insurance processing or field claims adjusting. Knowledge: Demonstrated knowledge of insurance theory and practices, insurance contracts and their application. Sophisticated knowledge of property claims standard methodologies and the legal aspects of court procedures affecting legal liability for all lines of insurance. Skills/Competencies: Excellent customer service skills and confirmed ability to meet customer needs and provide exemplary meaningful service by advising customers of the claims process and ensuring a positive customer experience. Demonstrated analytical skills needed to make decisions and resolve issues related to the application of coverage to submitted claims, application of laws of jurisdiction to investigation facts, application of policy exclusions and exceptions. Validated ability to establish repair requirements and cost estimates for extensive property damage losses and serves as a subject matter authority on respective claims projects. Proven organizational skills to effectively prioritize increased and sophisticated workloads. Demonstrates strong but flexible standards and be balanced based on the conflicting demands of the position. Excellent written and verbal communication skills necessary to effectively communicate and/or advise policyholders, claimants, repair persons, attorneys, agents, and general public. Demonstrated leadership capabilities to effectively train, mentor and provide feedback to less experienced associates. Ability to operate personal computer with proficient use of claims and business software. Staffing Exceptions to the above must be approved by business unit executive and Human Resources. Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates the Nationwide Values. Job Conditions: Overtime Eligibility: Not Eligible (Exempt) Working Conditions: Normal office or field claims environment. Representatives may be required to operate an automobile and have a valid driver's license with a safe driving record. Able to make physical inspections of property loss sites; climb ladders, balance at various heights, stoop and bend and/or crawl to inspect vehicles and structures; work outside in all types of weather. Must be willing to work irregular hours and to travel with possible overnight requirements. May be on-call. Must be available to work catastrophes (CAT). Familiarity with AI governance, validation, documentation, and human-in-the-loop controls. Experience working with large data sets and translating tax requirements into technology-enabled solutions. Candidate Profile The successful candidate will be a technically strong and motivated tax professional while demonstrating the strategic thinking and leadership potential necessary for future advancement within the organization. jobs.description: Want to be part of the team that keeps the world's largest cloud running? As an Engineering Operations Technician Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will get hands-on experience with the critical infrastructure behind Amazon's global data centers — and your work will directly impact millions of customers worldwide. This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Engineering Operations Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs. Who Should Apply We welcome applications from: Students who have completed — or due to complete before the internship end date — a higher education qualification (National Qualifications Framework level 4 to 6) or a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Electronic Engineering or similar fields. About the Role As an intern, you will provide technical support within Amazon's owned and operated data centers. Your work will ensure that the data center's mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems operate at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups on site. You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful. What You Will Do The Engineering Operations team is Amazon's front-line responders for hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. You will work with equipment that supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. This equipment includes, but is not limited to: - Stand-by diesel generators and switchgear - Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPSs) and Power Distribution Units (PDUs) - Air Handling Units (AHUs), chillers, and cooling towers - Chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs) - Building automation systems Your day-to-day duties include: - Maintaining mechanical and electrical equipment - Assisting with root cause analysis of equipment failures - Troubleshooting facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs) - Taking daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment - Using internal Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) to manage building workflows - Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors working on site Internship Structure Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for six consecutive months, starting in March/April 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Monday through Friday. Please note that full-time Engineering Operations Technician roles operate on a rotating shift pattern, which may include days, nights, weekends, and public holidays. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position. Amazon does not sponsor immigration for this role. South Africa Employment Equity Requirements In line with applicable legislation, preference will be given to eligible applicants from designated groups (that is, Black people (used as a collective term for Africans, Colored, Indians and Chinese) women, and persons with disabilities who are citizens of South Africa). Appointments will be made on merit and in accordance with organizational requirements. - Be a South African citizen with a valid Identity Document - Unemployed before joining the internship program. - Age requirement: below 35 years - Must have completed a higher education qualification in a related field (Minimum NQF level 4-6 qualification) - Qualification must be from an accredited institution of higher education Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying. As a
Principal QA Engineer

This role will work closely with and adjacent to the Senior Leadership Team in Sydney, helping shape strategic quality direction across the organisation. You will help teams shift quality left through stronger test automation, better tooling, clearer standards, and practical quality strategies that improve both developer experience and player experience. You will also help teams maintain confidence in quality in a world of AI-assisted development, where new tooling and workflows are changing how software is designed, implemented, and validated.
This is a full-time role, based in Sydney, Australia.
Responsibilities:
Own the quality approach for teams or product areas and ensure quality activities are considered across every stage of the software development lifecycle.
Lead initiatives that shift quality left through automation, tooling, and process improvements that help engineers catch issues earlier and ship with more confidence.
Identify, create, and evolve test frameworks and automation strategies that improve speed, coverage, sustainability, and reliability release over release.
Help define and implement test approaches as part of an overall quality and test strategy.
Help shape our approach to quality in an evolving AI landscape, including how teams use AI-assisted workflows responsibly and effectively while maintaining confidence in what we ship.
Use metrics and reporting to surface quality risks, trends, and opportunities, then turn those insights into action with product and discipline leaders.
Provide craft leadership and coaching for QA and partner disciplines, strengthening test design, planning, execution, and quality decision-making.
Help define, adapt, and socialise quality standards and practices that are usable across multiple teams and scalable at product or business-unit level.
Partner with engineering, delivery, design, creative, and production leaders to diagnose product and project quality risks and recommend targeted improvements.
Contribute to growing the quality craft through hiring, mentorship, and cross-team leadership.
Work in partnership with Game and Central teams to drive strategic initiatives.

8+ years of software quality assurance or quality engineering experience, with multiple proven product successes.
Experience defining and implementing test approaches as part of an overall test strategy.
Experience coaching QA team members on test design, planning, and execution.
Experience driving continuous improvement processes within a team or organization.
Experience leading or maturing automated testing frameworks, tools, or processes that improve sustainable development.

Experience working effectively across disciplines and influencing teams beyond direct reporting lines.
Experience handling multiple simultaneous projects and partners
Experience tasking or partnering with remote teams and providing feedback on effectiveness.
Experience establishing product or business-unit quality standards, practices, or operating models.
History of leading strategic quality initiatives with broad organisational impact.
Strong judgment in ambiguous problem spaces, with the ability to evaluate, scope, and execute solutions with team, initiative, or business-unit impact.
Strong technical acumen, with the ability to engage deeply with engineers on systems, tooling, automation, and development workflows.

Experience in game development environments and supporting or shipping games.
Development or quality experience across multiple platforms such as mobile, console, and PC.
Familiarity with CI/CD maturity, release quality, and build or delivery workflows.

Relevant certifications such as ISTQB Foundation, ISTQB Agile Tester, ISTQB Expert Level, ISTQB Advanced Test Manager, or ICAgile Test Expert.
For this role, you’ll find success through:
Deep quality craft expertise and a strong point of view on how to build quality into development, not inspect it in the end.
Strong technical credibility with engineers and the ability to translate quality goals into practical technical solutions.
The ability to make a meaningful impact on how teams work and on the quality of the end product at a business-unit level.
A collaborative style that helps engineers and partner disciplines feel ownership of quality outcomes.
Decision-making that consistently prioritizes better developer workflows and better player experiences.
The ability to operate as a recognised craft expert across multiple dimensions of QA engineering.
For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. Medical Insurance that covers you and your dependents
Employee Assistance Program

Learning and Development opportunities

put players first

Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree
Strong working knowledge of residential appraisal methodologies, including the cost, sales comparison, and income approaches to value
Demonstrated experience reviewing Uniform Residential Appraisal Reports (URARs), Broker Price Opinions (BPOs), and Automated Valuation Models (AVMs)
Thorough understanding of evolving appraisal regulations (USPAP, Dodd-Frank, GSE requirements) and secondary market valuation trends
Deep understanding of residential mortgage credit underwriting standards and key performance metrics (DTI, LTV, FICO, reserves, etc.)

Hands-on experience in secondary market operations, post-close quality control, or investor-level loan review
4–5+ years of progressive experience in residential mortgage whole loan valuations, operations, and/or acquisition diligence
Versatile, innovative, and analytical professional who is a critical thinker with the ability to synthesize complex data into clear conclusions
Excellent attention to detail with strong organizational skills and effective time management in a fast-paced environment
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present findings, collaborate cross-functionally, and perform effectively in a deadline-driven environment

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including data analysis, pivot tables, and scenario modeling

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
Anthropic's EMEA Startups team works with the companies building AI-native products on Claude, from Seed through Series B and beyond. The Growth Account Executive owns a portfolio of startups that are already building on Claude and is responsible for growing that relationship: deepening Claude's role in the customer's product, structuring the commercial agreements that support their scale, and defending the account as the competitive landscape shifts.
This is a consultative role. Native AI companies move fast, change direction often, and make decisions on technical merit. Earning a seat at the table means building real relationships with founders and technical leaders, understanding their product and roadmap as well as they do, and helping them build on the frontier — bringing them the latest models and capabilities early, showing them what's possible, and turning that into adoption. Commercial outcomes follow from that trust.
You work closely with our Applied AI (AAI) team, who bring deep technical partnership to our highest-potential accounts, but you are expected to understand what each customer is building and identify the next use case yourself. Helping customers build on the frontier is part of this job, not something you hand off.
Responsibilities
Own a portfolio of high-potential AI-native startups across EMEA, with full accountability for revenue growth and retention
Build long-term, trusted relationships with founders, CTOs and technical leads, acting as their advisor on how to build with Claude
Help customers build on the frontier: bring new model releases and capabilities to them early, work through where they apply, and drive adoption into the core of the product
Develop use cases: understand each customer's product and roadmap, identify where Claude can go deeper, and make it happen
Structure, size and time usage-based commitments, including multi-surface agreements across the Claude API, Claude Code and Claude for Work
Navigate competitive pressure, including aggressive discounting, with a clear point of view on value rather than price
Partner with the Applied AI team on technical strategy for your accounts and coordinate their involvement where it creates the most leverage
Build and maintain relationships across the EMEA VC and accelerator ecosystem to source and qualify pipeline
Bring structured feedback from your portfolio to Product and Go-to-Market leadership
You may be a good fit if you have
5+ years of quota-carrying experience in consumption or usage-based sales at a cloud provider, infrastructure, data platform or developer tools company
A track record of expanding existing accounts: you have carried a growth or expansion number and understand how commits, credits and usage curves work
A consultative selling style, with evidence that customers treat you as an advisor rather than a vendor
Experience selling to early- and growth-stage startups and comfort with the pace and informality of founder-led companies
Enough technical depth to hold a credible conversation with a CTO about APIs, model selection and AI product architecture, and to recognise where a new capability fits
Existing relationships in the European startup, VC or accelerator ecosystem
Fluency in English; additional European languages are a plus
Strong candidates often have
Time inside a startup, not just selling to them
Hands-on experience building with LLMs, even on side projects
A history of describing wins by what the customer built rather than the size of the deal

We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us.

How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
